# ISRCTN metadata test excerpts

Reduced default-XML excerpts retrieved 2026-10-06 from the public ISRCTN query
API for ISRCTN30295544, ISRCTN18275142, ISRCTN10612149 and ISRCTN03467700.
Only record IDs, planned outcomes and report metadata are retained. Contacts,
IPD prose, creator identifiers and internal production notes are omitted.
The exact raw query response and its hash are isolated in ops/task259 for review;
these four field-level fixtures are not a canonical registry corpus.
Historical fixture counts are pinned tests, not fixed live-count expectations.
No linked articles or attachments were fetched. Source record:
https://www.isrctn.com/ followed by the fixture's ISRCTN identifier.
